exercises.title: Superkey, candidate key, primary key, foreign key
exercises.problemHtml:
Use the University schema: Student(sid, name, major), Course(cid, title, credits), Enroll(sid, cid, score).

This set has 5 questions. There is nothing to run: answer in the panel on the right and press Submit. Work each one out yourself first (on paper, or in SSMS on your own SQL Server), then check — every explanation after Submit says why the tempting wrong answer is wrong.

Requirements

  • Answer every question in the answer panel, then press Submit.
  • All answers must be correct to get Accepted; the explanation of every question appears after you submit.

solutionCodeJson.name: answers.md
solutionCodeJson.code:
# Superkey, candidate key, primary key, foreign key — answer key

1. {sid, name} uniquely identifies a student. It is…{sid, name} xác định duy nhất một sinh viên. Nó là…
   Answer: a) a superkey but not a candidate key
   It is unique (superkey), but not minimal: {sid} alone is already unique, so name is redundant.VI: Nó duy nhất (siêu khoá) nhưng không tối thiểu: chỉ {sid} đã duy nhất, name là thừa.

2. What is the key of Enroll?Khoá của Enroll là gì?
   Answer: d) {sid, cid}
   A student takes many courses and a course has many students, so neither alone is unique; the pair is, and it is minimal.VI: Một sinh viên học nhiều môn, một môn có nhiều sinh viên nên riêng từng cột không duy nhất; cặp thì duy nhất và tối thiểu.

3. Enroll.sid → Student.sid is…Enroll.sid → Student.sid là…
   Answer: c) a foreign key: every sid in Enroll must exist in Student
   A foreign key references the key of another relation (referential integrity).VI: Khoá ngoại tham chiếu khoá của quan hệ khác (toàn vẹn tham chiếu).

4. Student also stores a unique email. Then Student has…Student có thêm email duy nhất. Khi đó Student có…
   Answer: d) two candidate keys, {sid} and {email}; one is chosen as primary key
   Every minimal unique set is a candidate key; the designer picks ONE as primary, the other gets UNIQUE.VI: Mọi tập duy nhất tối thiểu đều là khoá ứng viên; người thiết kế chọn MỘT làm khoá chính, cái kia đặt UNIQUE.

5. Can a primary-key attribute be NULL?Thuộc tính của khoá chính có được NULL?
   Answer: b) No — entity integrity: every tuple must be identifiable
   Entity integrity forbids NULL in the primary key; SQL makes PK columns NOT NULL.VI: Toàn vẹn thực thể cấm NULL trong khoá chính; SQL tự đặt NOT NULL cho cột khoá chính.

Answer key / Đáp án

  1. a) a superkey but not a candidate key

    It is unique (superkey), but not minimal: {sid} alone is already unique, so name is redundant.

    VI: Nó duy nhất (siêu khoá) nhưng không tối thiểu: chỉ {sid} đã duy nhất, name là thừa.

  2. d) {sid, cid}

    A student takes many courses and a course has many students, so neither alone is unique; the pair is, and it is minimal.

    VI: Một sinh viên học nhiều môn, một môn có nhiều sinh viên nên riêng từng cột không duy nhất; cặp thì duy nhất và tối thiểu.

  3. c) a foreign key: every sid in Enroll must exist in Student

    A foreign key references the key of another relation (referential integrity).

    VI: Khoá ngoại tham chiếu khoá của quan hệ khác (toàn vẹn tham chiếu).

  4. d) two candidate keys, {sid} and {email}; one is chosen as primary key

    Every minimal unique set is a candidate key; the designer picks ONE as primary, the other gets UNIQUE.

    VI: Mọi tập duy nhất tối thiểu đều là khoá ứng viên; người thiết kế chọn MỘT làm khoá chính, cái kia đặt UNIQUE.

  5. b) No — entity integrity: every tuple must be identifiable

    Entity integrity forbids NULL in the primary key; SQL makes PK columns NOT NULL.

    VI: Toàn vẹn thực thể cấm NULL trong khoá chính; SQL tự đặt NOT NULL cho cột khoá chính.

exercises.title: Could it be a key? Judge from the instance
exercises.problemHtml:
Look at the sample data of University (Student: SE01 An SE, SE02 Bình SE, AI01 Chi AI, SE03 An SE, GD01 Dũng GD). For each attribute set of Student, answer whether this instance refutes it as a key (two tuples share the value).

This set has 1 table. There is nothing to run: answer in the panel on the right and press Submit. Work each one out yourself first (on paper, or in SSMS on your own SQL Server), then check — every explanation after Submit says why the tempting wrong answer is wrong.

Requirements

  • Answer every question in the answer panel, then press Submit.
  • All answers must be correct to get Accepted; the explanation of every question appears after you submit.

exercises.title: Show that name is not a key of Student
exercises.problemHtml:
Find every name shared by more than one student, with how many students have it.

University schema (lesson 2.5 — full script in the University.sql tab)
TableColumns
Studentsid CHAR(4), name NVARCHAR(20), major CHAR(2)
Coursecid CHAR(6), title NVARCHAR(30), credits INT
Enrollsid, cid, score DECIMAL(3,1)

5 students (two different students are both called An: SE01 and SE03; GD01 Dũng takes nothing), 4 courses (nobody takes JPD113), 7 enrolments.

Requirements

  • Columns: name, students.
  • Row order does not matter.

FROM Student

exercises.title: Courses that no student takes
exercises.problemHtml:
The foreign key Enroll.cid → Course.cid guarantees every enrolment points at a real course — but nothing forces a course to have enrolments. List the courses (cid, title) that appear in no Enroll row.

University schema (lesson 2.5 — full script in the University.sql tab)
TableColumns
Studentsid CHAR(4), name NVARCHAR(20), major CHAR(2)
Coursecid CHAR(6), title NVARCHAR(30), credits INT
Enrollsid, cid, score DECIMAL(3,1)

5 students (two different students are both called An: SE01 and SE03; GD01 Dũng takes nothing), 4 courses (nobody takes JPD113), 7 enrolments.

Requirements

  • Columns: cid, title.
  • Row order does not matter.
exercises.problemHtmlVi:
Khoá ngoại Enroll.cid → Course.cid bảo đảm mọi lượt đăng ký trỏ tới môn có thật — nhưng không có gì buộc một môn phải có người đăng ký. Liệt kê các môn (cid, title) không xuất hiện trong dòng Enroll nào.
